sources.name: Jan Aushadhi Product & MRP List (PMBJP)
sources.publisher: Pharmaceuticals & Medical Devices Bureau of India, Department of Pharmaceuticals, Government of India
sources.license: Published publicly by the Government of India; no separate open-data licence stated
sources.attribution: Product names, pack sizes, MRPs and therapeutic groups from the PMBJP Product & MRP List published by PMBI.
sources.notes: Generic medicines sold at Jan Aushadhi Kendras, with official MRPs. The list does not state drug schedules: anything outside vitamins, antiseptics and similar groups defaults to Schedule H (prescription) — confirm against the label. GST defaults to 5% (the rate for most medicines from 22 Sep 2025; some life-saving drugs are nil). Products without a published MRP and non-medicines are left out.
